findings.title: The concurrency test can pass without observing concurrent reads
findings.body: The reader thread is neither synchronized with the deletion loop nor joined before `caughtExceptions` is asserted. Deletions can finish before the reader makes a request, and an in-flight request can add an exception after the assertion, so this test can pass without exercising the race or detecting its failure. If deletion throws before `deletedAll` is set, the non-daemon reader also loops indefinitely. Use a start barrier and stop the reader in a `finally` block, then join it before asserting.
